scope: Target2016 ordinary MM Flick/Countdown LOT6 scheduling and direction compensation

rules.start: 848>0 subtract dt and return even on crossing
rules.retarget: 87c>0 subtract dt and return even on crossing
rules.valid: steer first;754>758+local writes758 and87c then searches from old aim
rules.dead: old resolved targetHP<=0+local clears all UID slots then searches from mesh
rules.invalid: local and750>=754>=758 search from mesh; do not immediately steer at new result
rules.failedStore: out-type starts0 and selector writes only on success, failure clears NPC slot, retains User pair
rules.compensation: mode2/3/4 steer at currentXYZ+(mesh47c*forwardX,0,mesh47c*forwardZ); no extra mesh translation

qualification: Web object collection/identity and unchanged qualified vector turning remain host adapters; counters and timers are explicit instance values
